interface.shortDescription: Product management skills for AI agents
interface.longDescription: 68 product management skills across the full product lifecycle, including PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, OKRs, lean canvas, personas, meeting artifacts, discovery synthesis, measurement planning, release notes, workshop tools, workflow authoring and ad-hoc chaining, and pm-skills lifecycle utilities. v2.31.1 is a maintenance patch: it removes the paths filter that let the required validate-plugin CI check silently deadlock every site-only PR (nine PRs stuck for three weeks), drains the dependency security queue from ten open Dependabot alerts (four high) to zero (astro 7.1.6, starlight 0.41.5, sharp, svgo, dompurify, postcss, js-yaml, CI actions), declares @astrojs/markdown-remark as the direct dependency the site's link resolver needs on astro 7.1, stops shadowing Starlight's built-in draft field (which emptied the production route collection under Starlight 0.41.4+), and fixes a SIGPIPE race that made the bash AGENTS.md sync validator nondeterministically report present entries as missing. No new skills; catalog stays 68 / 6 sub-agents. v2.31.0 is the zero-drift release: it makes generation the only write path for the README catalog, quickstarts, compat matrix, manifest descriptions, and release notes, stands up release-please in shadow behind a PR-title lint, ports two awk-hazard validators to single-source Node, lifts trigger-fixture coverage to 43 of 68 skills, and adds an output-eval CI lane plus SECURITY.md and provenance-page expansions; no new skills, catalog stays 68 skills / 6 sub-agents.
